Y_a_summary.scope: All returned official CCD footprints intersecting one predeclared tangent square, every physical exposure queried with independent COUNT and row checks. Two metadata search margins give identical intersecting chips. Conditional catalogue-measurement coverage, not proof of unknown chips outside the search or image extraction completeness. Object IDs describe retrieval labels only, never new-association truth. Every actual band is retained; no TOP/sample exposure cap.

dcr_blind-zero_b_16_00_summary.scope: Frozen source/member/held identities, original global C0 and identical-local-graph D0/D1 controls. No QSO coefficient training or held-year target fitting. Synchronous joint group/beta draws plus one measured color perturbation per source shared across training and held. Unknown color/SED/systematic errors remain unqualified; no adopted model.

inputs/b_16_00.scope: All NSC object-centroid aliases in the declared core+halo, no ndetr/rmag/nphotr/filter cut; count-checked meas join and physical-ID dedup. Original SDSS r detections preserved exactly including every physical run. Object labels go only to separate auxiliary labels, not association input. Source identities still require blind association. Halo/object-centroid selection and published-measurement extraction limits remain; actual exposure-cell comparison is separate from image completeness.

errors/b_16_00.scope: Exactly frozen training members and same C0-gated held positions. Error parameters frozen from v1.4 disjoint galaxy training before these stellar tests; QSO point metrics retained separately and never train parameters. Explicit independent/night/reference full4x4 components; held-night covariance subtracts shared train-held night terms at calendar-year edges. Within-band versus fully shared-instrument nights bracket unknown cross-band correlation. Parameter-learning and unmodeled spatial systematics remain unqualified; no automatic adoption.
